subject.title: feat(feishu): bot-to-bot conversation support with @mention handling

question: Should Feishu omitted allowBots continue accepting bot-authored group messages by default with shared loop protection, or should this PR require a more restrictive opt-in default before merge?
rationale: The PR changes channel admission defaults, live Feishu notification behavior, and bot-loop suppression policy; automation can review code quality but cannot choose the product upgrade posture for existing Feishu installations.

options.title: Approve Current Default After Refresh
options.body: Preserve omitted allowBots as accepting bot-authored Feishu messages, require a conflict-resolved head, and treat shared loop protection as the upgrade guard.

options.title: Require Restrictive Default
options.body: Change Feishu so bot-authored messages require allowBots true or allowBots "mentions", aligning with more conservative sibling-channel posture at the cost of changing the PR's preserved-current-behavior claim.

options.title: Pause For Plugin Owner
options.body: Hold the PR until the Feishu plugin owner explicitly chooses the bot-admission default and notification policy.

recommendation.title: Approve Current Default After Refresh
recommendation.body: Preserve omitted allowBots as accepting bot-authored Feishu messages, require a conflict-resolved head, and treat shared loop protection as the upgrade guard.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Feishu channel/config history makes this the strongest current-main routing candidate for the default and merge-safety choice.
